doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Buck Clayton, Basie records and first hearing Dizzy's band
summary: He names Buck Clayton as a favorite trumpeter and recalls Willie Cook leading Dizzy's trumpets.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: You talked a little more about your trumpet playing in the book. One trumpeter we didn’t mention earlier was Buck Clayton, who you cite here as your favorite trumpet player.
So you must have been listening to the Basie records.
Yeah, I was listening to the Basie records...
So you knew about Lester Young already.
We already spoke about Louis Armstrong. But would you say that listening to swing music when you were a teenager also had a big effect on you?
I don’t know. It’s hard to say what has an effect on you. [LAUGHS]
Sure. Do you remember what it was like for you when heard Dizzy Gillespie’s band for the first time, or when you first heard bebop?
I didn’t hear the band at... Willie Cook was playing the lead trumpet, and they had a lot of good musicians, and... I just remember hearing that band, and taking a liking to it. I don’t know...
